sara (PM): Heads-up: ACME asked for a predictable path to enable eval-triggered alerts + quantization suggestions. They insisted on tenant opt-in and an audit trail. We need to decide pilot scope and gating.

miguel (CS): They also want a webhook per tenant that posts a consolidated weekly scorecard and a hard-stop alert when key prompts drop >5%. Prefer JSON payload + HMAC signature.

anika (ML): Suggest we standardize signals first. My proposal: concordance_p95, hallucination_rate_top10, latency_p99. Regression = relative drop vs baseline over 7-day rolling average. Default regress threshold = 0.05 (5%).

kai (Eng): From infra side: two pieces - alert infra (ingest eval deltas, generate alerts, webhook/delivery) and recs infra (compute quant profiles, simulate perf). Both should be behind flags. Minimal canary: internal + one alpha tenant.

lina (Design): UX ask: show recommended quant profiles next to the alert with an explainer: expected cost savings, expected latency delta, measured quality delta. Small CTA: "Propose to tenant" and "Apply (audit)".

sara (PM): Draft launch criteria for pilot: 1) Deploy to internal + 2 alpha tenants, 2) Alert precision >= 75% on top-50 prompts, 3) Quant recs accurate: when applied, quality delta < 1% in 85% cases. Pilot length = 6 weeks.

anika (ML): Agree but want to add metric: time-to-detect (TTD) median < 7 days for regressions. Also propose we run backtests on last 12 months of data for 6 existing customers to validate false-positive rate.

kai (Eng): Storage/compute risk: storing per-tenant eval history could be ~50-200GB/mo depending on sampling. We can store compressed deltas and keep full traces for 30 days. Also need rate-limits on webhook retries to avoid pager storms.

miguel (CS): Legal/consent: must capture explicit tenant opt-in for eval telemetry. CS will draft consent language and list of required fields for alpha customers. Also: audit log requirement for any "Apply" action.

sara (PM): Roadmap placement: slot pilot in sprint 7 (kickoff next Tue). GA if pilot passes acceptance gates in 3 subsequent sprints. Does that timeline look ok?

kai (Eng): Fine. I'll break into two epics and size: alert core (3 devs, ~4 sprints) + quant-sim + UI glue (2 devs, ~3 sprints).

anika (ML): Action items for ML: publish signal taxonomy, implement simulation harness, run sims, provide weights for scoring function. Tentative scoring formula: score = (concordance_drop*100) + (hallucination_increase*1.5) - (latency_improvement*0.4) - (cost_saving_percent*0.3). Lower is better; recommend if score <= 2.0.

lina (Design): I'll prototype the alert card and the "recommendation detail" modal by EOW.

miguel (CS): CS action: recruit 2 alpha customers (ACME + one more), capture opt-in, coordinate SSO and webhook endpoints.

kai (Eng): Ops-bot: create feature flag scaffold and ephemeral staging to demo to ACME?

ops-bot: Flag created: ff/eval-alerts-2026 on branch feat/eval-alerts. Staging environment provisioned. CI job queued. :white_check_mark:

sara (PM): Thanks — I'll consolidate into a one-page PRD (scope, acceptance gates, risks, owners) and post for review. Can each owner drop a short weekly update in this thread?

anika (ML): Will post sims by Friday.

kai (Eng): Will add epic cards and initial estimates by EOD tomorrow.

miguel (CS): Reaching out to ACME today.

lina (Design): Prototype link coming tonight.

sara (PM): Great. If anyone has pushback on the gating numbers, reply here. Otherwise marking this as scope agreed for pilot planning. :thumbsup:
